objective: Build a real calendar-true HTF parent candle (the repo currently has an HTF reset CLOCK, HTFBuilder, with zero OHLC aggregation) plus a 3-candle CRT construct (C1 range / C2 manipulation / C3 distribution) on top of it, register 9 SMC primitives absent from the codebase (order block, FVG, breaker, mitigation, PDH/PDL, EQH/EQL, CHoCH) as canonical vector features (39->48), and promote a new active version v2_htfcrt_2026_08 with the arm ON. User-authorized per session plan approval 2026-08-15 (AskUserQuestion: 3-candle wiring=new CRT states, TF ladder=H4+D1+W1+MN1, Bucket B scope=all 9 primitives, default arm=ON immediately, feature repr=canonical vector slots 39->48). Source: SujanTraderCRTExp.txt / SujanTraderCrtExpPart2.txt study (docs/implementation_plan/study-sujantrader-docs-composed-snowflake.md).
change_class_rationale: FEATURE_IDENTITY_CHANGE + DATASET_SCHEMA_CHANGE + DERIVED_METRIC_CHANGE cover the 9 new FM-ids and the CANONICAL_FEATURES 39->48 vector growth. MODEL_INPUT_CHANGE + MODEL_TRAINING_CHANGE + MODEL_ARTIFACT_CHANGE cover the mandatory recapture/retrain of all 6 model families (zone_gate/rr/rr_fusion/gaussian/bitnet/tradenet) once the vector dimension moves. RUNTIME_DECISION_PATH_CHANGE covers the new CRT states (9->12), VALID_TRANSITIONS extension, and the parent_state bridge into process_candle -- a declared behavior change, not a parity-preserving one, per user decision (arm ON, ledger changes accepted). PRODUCTION_CONFIG_CHANGE + ACTIVE_MODEL_CHANGE cover authoring and promoting configs/production/v2_htfcrt_2026_08.json and flipping ACTIVE_VERSION.

unknowns.detail: Whether all 6 model families can be recaptured/retrained on the existing corpus within this program, or whether some (e.g. tradenet, a .pth binary with no registry dim field) require a separately authorized retrain program.

resample()'s documented determinism guarantee (resample(resample(x,H1),H4)==resample(x,H4)) provably fails at the W1->MN1 rung (a week can straddle a month boundary). Phase 1 documents this as an explicit carve-out rather than resolving it -- flagged as a permanent, not temporary, limitation.

rollback_boundary: Phased, dependency-ordered commits (Phase 0 through Phase 6 per docs/implementation_plan/study-sujantrader-docs-composed-snowflake.md). Each phase is independently revertable via git; the ACTIVE_VERSION flip (Phase 4) is the single irreversible-in-place step and is rollback-safe only via the archived {version}_archived_{ts}.json + promotion_log.jsonl PROMOTED/rollback trail (docs/reference/governance.md rollback procedure). Freeze-pin waiver_log entries preserve the pre-change baseline (results/baseline/20260815T112746Z_pre_htfcrt/manifest.json) as the comparison point.
